title: com.integraledger.legal_context — UCP capability configuration
description: The `config` payload of the `com.integraledger.legal_context` UCP capability. A declaration states what a counterparty REQUIRES of an agreement's Agentic Transaction Record before it will transact. Reading one obliges nobody and emitting one commits no counterparty: it is a pre-filter, so that two parties who cannot possibly agree find out before a payment is attempted rather than after. `2026-07-30` is the date this capability was defined, not the date of any host specification, and dated paths are immutable — a new version adds a path and never edits one. This document describes a technology harness. It asserts nothing about whether any agreement is lawful, sound or enforceable.

minimumLevel.description: The lowest LCP §3 trust level this party will accept. REQUIRED: a declaration that requires nothing is not an advertisement, and emitting one would put a field on the wire that says only that LCP was mentioned here.

acceptedJurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions this party will accept. OMIT the field to constrain nothing — an empty array is not 'no constraint', because read literally it accepts nothing and would refuse every counterparty on earth.

acceptedDisputeMethods.description: Dispute-resolution methods this party will accept. Omit to constrain nothing, for the same reason as acceptedJurisdictions.
